text:
jia: Quick idea — can we ship a compact 'per-model snapshot' card in the console that shows token burn, cache savings, and an estimated unit econ for the last 1h/24h?

matt: love the idea. is this the same as the mini ROI widget we sketched?

jia: similar but leaner. goal: one-line signal for PMs + hover for drilldown. tight SLA on render time (<200ms).

anya: UX q: do we show raw token counts or normalized cost per 1k tokens? product will likely want both.

jia: propose columns: model, tokens, cache_saved_tokens, effective_cost_usd, latency_p50. default to normalized cost per 1k but show raw on hover.

sara: need to account for routing discounts and dedicated capacity amortization. otherwise cost could be misleading.

jia: good call — include a flag for "apply routing multipliers" (off by default) + tooltip explaining assumptions.

matt: how expensive is the query? analytics pipeline currently samples heavily. we might need a light aggregate endpoint from the router service.

analytics-bot: note: current per-model aggregates are 5s windowed and live in clickhouse table model_burn_agg. sampling_rate=0.1 for high-cardinality tenants.

anya: if we depend on that table, we need a fallback when sampling drops. could show a confidence badge.

jia: yes — confidence badge + tooltip: "estimate based on sampled telemetry (x% coverage)". UX should gray out low-confidence numbers.

sara: quotas angle — if a tenant is quota throttled, token counts are artificially low. should we tag the card with a "quota-limited" marker?

matt: we can surface a small warning icon that links to the quota timeline. implement: router emits a quota_event counter per tenant per minute. join on tenant_id.

jia: implementation plan sketch: 
```
GET /internal/console/v1/model_snapshot?model=redwood/fast-1&tenant=acme&window=1h
response: { model, tokens, cache_saved_tokens, effective_cost_usd, sample_fraction, quota_limited }
```
Notes: require low-latency cache (redis) populated by a streaming job that upserts aggregates from clickhouse.

matt: +1 on cache. also include p50 latency from a separate timeseries store, TTL 60s.

anya: rollout idea: start in preview for internal tenants only. expose an opt-in toggle in the console. track CTR on the card expand to measure usefulness.

sara: for accuracy, add a daily reconcile job that computes exact costs (batch) so console numbers can link to an authoritative invoice view.

jia: ops question — what about rate limit attack surface? if the console card fires many requests on page load we could DDoS our own router.

matt: mitigate: server-side render snapshot in console backend, fetch once per page load per user session, debounce per 30s, and respect per-tenant read quotas.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/mini-cost-card -> staging at 2026-03-23T15:12:00Z

anya: small UX nit — make the confidence badge color-blind safe (patterns + color).

jia: noted. next steps: matt to prototype endpoint + cache; anya to mock UX states (high sample / low sample / quota-limited); sara to write reconciliation spec. I'll own the RFC.

matt: will start prototype tomorrow, will ping infra if we need additional ClickHouse indices.

jia: thanks all. filing a follow-up RFC doc and a short PRD. :thumbsup:
